events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its very first music video.

angles.name: Radio Star
angles.copy: On this day, 45 years ago, MTV launched with a song that ironically declared "Video Killed The Radio Star". We're still here, aren't we?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since three days of peace and music changed everything. Remembering the iconic Woodstock Festival. What's your favourite performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music still moves generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders and an absolute icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: A very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The definitive voice of a generation.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy's cinematic debut. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His vision of peace and timeless music continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British institution.
